full_description: Job Description We are seeking an innovative and hands-on AI Security Engineer to design, develop, and implement AI-powered solutions that transform traditional cybersecurity processes through intelligent automation, agentic AI, and secure software engineering. This role will primarily focus on developing autonomous and semi-autonomous AI agents to identify, analyze, correlate, and prioritize security vulnerabilities; generate remediation recommendations; automate secure code and dependency fixes; validate proposed changes; create GitHub pull requests; and proactively engage application owners through intelligent notification and escalation workflows. The engineer will build AI-driven capabilities to streamline vulnerability remediation across application code, APIs, software dependencies, container images, and cloud environments. A key objective is to reduce manual remediation effort, accelerate vulnerability closure, improve reporting accuracy, and enable application teams to address security risks more efficiently. The engineer will also contribute to AI-driven innovations across Cryptographic Metadata, Automated Assurance, and Cryptographic Lifecycle Visibility, improving security posture, inventory accuracy, compliance, and proactive risk management. The ideal candidate is a strong Python developer with practical experience in AI/LLM technologies, AI agent development, REST API integrations, GitHub automation, CI/CD pipelines, and secure software development. The candidate should be comfortable building production-quality automation solutions and applying emerging AI capabilities to solve real-world cybersecurity challenges. Responsibilities AI Agent Development & Innovation: Design, develop, and deploy intelligent AI agents using LLMs, agentic AI frameworks, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool/function calling, and workflow orchestration to automate vulnerability management and cryptographic security processes. AI-Driven Vulnerability Detection & Remediation: Develop AI-powered solutions to analyze application code, GitHub repositories, dependencies, APIs, and container images; identify security vulnerabilities; generate secure remediation recommendations; and automate code and dependency fixes. Automated Code Fixes & GitHub Integration: Build intelligent agents capable of generating remediation code, updating vulnerable dependencies, executing automated tests and security validations, and creating GitHub pull requests for application owner review and approval. Intelligent Workflow Automation: Implement automated pull request monitoring, application owner notifications, remediation tracking, and escalation workflows. For example, trigger configurable email or collaboration-tool reminders when remediation pull requests remain unreviewed or unmerged beyond defined thresholds, such as 24 hours. AI-Driven Vulnerability Triage & Correlation: Develop AI-powered workflows to correlate findings, security scanners, and application repositories; identify potential duplicate or stale findings; analyze severity reclassifications; and distinguish actionable vulnerabilities from reporting discrepancies. Automated Remediation Validation: Develop workflows to validate remediation effectiveness through automated testing, security rescans, deployment verification, and vulnerability status reconciliation. Ensure findings are accurately tracked through remediation and closure. Cryptographic Metadata & Discovery: Develop AI-powered capabilities to discover cryptographic algorithms, certificates, keys, libraries, configurations, and dependencies across applications and repositories, improving inventory accuracy and risk visibility. Automated Cryptographic Assurance: Build intelligent solutions that evaluate cryptographic implementations against enterprise security policies, identify noncompliant configurations, assess cryptographic risks, and recommend remediation actions. Cryptographic Lifecycle Intelligence: Develop proactive monitoring and AI-driven workflows to identify expiring certificates, deprecated algorithms, key rotation requirements, and cryptographic migration opportunities. Security Platform & API Integration: Integrate AI agents with GitHub APIs, vulnerability APIs, AI Harness assessment results, vulnerability management platforms, and enterprise security tools to automate security analysis, risk prioritization, remediation workflows, and reporting. AI-Powered Security Insights & Reporting: Develop automated dashboards, vulnerability trend analysis, risk prioritization, remediation recommendations, and application owner notifications using findings from multiple security data sources. Enable visibility into new vulnerabilities, severity reclassifications, remediation progress, and outstanding security risks. AI Agent Reliability & Security Controls: Implement secure AI agent workflows with appropriate human approval, least-privilege access, audit logging, input/output validation, and safeguards against prompt injection or unauthorized actions. Evaluate AI-generated remediation recommendations for correctness, security, and reliability before implementation. Engineering & Collaboration: Write maintainable, reusable, and well-tested Python code; develop scalable automation components; integrate solutions into CI/CD pipelines; and collaborate with security engineering, application development, DevSecOps, and infrastructure teams to deploy reliable AI-driven security solutions. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Cybersecurity, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 2–4 years of hands-on experience in software development, automation engineering, DevSecOps, security engineering, or related technical roles. Strong programming skills in Python, including scripting, REST API integrations, JSON processing, data manipulation, error handling, automated testing, and development of reusable automation components. Practical experience developing applications or automation solutions using Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs), including prompt engineering, tool/function calling, structured outputs, and AI agent workflows. Familiarity with AI agent frameworks and orchestration technologies such as LangChain, LangGraph or equivalent frameworks. Experience working with GitHub, Git workflows, pull requests, repository automation, and CI/CD pipelines. Understanding of software security fundamentals, vulnerability identification, secure coding practices, dependency management, and vulnerability remediation workflows. Working knowledge of common application security vulnerabilities and remediation approaches involving APIs, open-source dependencies, container images, and application code. Familiarity with security scanning tools, vulnerability management platforms, or CTEM concepts, including vulnerability prioritization, risk scoring, remediation tracking, and validation. Experience with REST API integrations, scheduled automation, event-driven workflows, and integration of multiple enterprise systems. Understanding of secure software development practices, including code reviews, unit testing, automated security testing, and deployment validation. Awareness of AI application security considerations, including prompt injection, sensitive-data handling, least-privilege access, human-in-the-loop approval, and validation of AI-generated outputs. Basic knowledge of cryptographic security concepts, including encryption algorithms, TLS, digital certificates, cryptographic libraries, and key management. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate cybersecurity requirements into practical engineering and automation solutions. full_description: We are looking for Senior AI Engineers with hands-on experience designing and deploying scalable AI solutions. In this role, you will be part of a cross-functional team working on cutting-edge projects involving Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), agentic frameworks, and end-to-end MLOps workflows. You’ll play a key role in developing AI applications using tools like LangChain, CrewAI, and Google ADK, while applying advanced prompt engineering techniques and ensuring robust monitoring and performance tracing. Your collaboration with other engineering will help align innovative AI systems with broader development goals. What is this position about? Design, develop, and deploy AI solutions. Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and fine-tuning techniques. Utilize and integrate AI frameworks like LangChain. Use advanced prompt engineering techniques to solve complex problems with LLMs. Build and manage agentic frameworks such as CrewAI and Google ADK. Apply MLOps best practices to streamline AI development workflows. Monitor and trace AI applications performance. Collaborate across teams to ensure alignment with traditional ML and AI methodologies. Work on end-to-end software engineering for scalable solutions. Qualifications 4+ years of experience in building and deploying AI/ML or GenAI solutions in production environments. Strong experience with at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP) for building and deploying AI/ML solutions. Experience with services such as Azure ML, AWS Bedrock/SageMaker, GCP Vertex AI, Databricks, or equivalent AI/ML platforms is preferred. Proficiency in Python and major ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn). Hands-on experience with RAG architecture, prompt engineering, and LLM-based application development. Experience with MLOps/LLMOps pipelines, model tracking, observability, and CI/CD using tools such as Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, MLflow, or equivalent platforms. Familiarity with enterprise data integration and orchestration tools such as Azure Data Factory, Synapse, Databricks, Airflow, Kafka, or equivalent distributed data platforms. Strong backend engineering and API development experience using FastAPI, Flask, Node.js, or similar frameworks, with ability to build scalable AI-powered services and microservices. Excellent problem-solving, debugging, and collaboration skills. Good to Have Experience building production-grade RAG systems using vector databases such as Pinecone, FAISS, ChromaDB, pgvector, Milvus, or Azure AI Search. Experience with agentic AI frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, MCP, or Google ADK. Familiarity with AI observability and evaluation tools such as LangSmith, Langfuse, RAGAS, MLflow, App Insights, or Prometheus/Grafana. Experience deploying AI systems using Docker, Kubernetes, serverless architectures, or container orchestration platforms.

title: Software Development Engineer II
skills: Python, Machine Learning, AWS, Kubernetes, GitHub, Spark, FastAPI
full_description: At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business. Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere. Software Development Engineer II, ML Systems — Marketing (Meta/SEM Bidding) Introduction to the team We create and deliver an aligned, dedicated marketing strategy to fuel each Expedia Group brand's success. Since our travelers interact with us through our brands, we have a brand focus in our marketing, while leveraging the scale and efficiency we've built in functional expertise. The Meta/SEM Bidding Programs team builds and operates the high-scale data and machine learning systems that power our bidding programs. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer II who writes clean, reliable, production-grade software and partners closely with machine learning engineers to build the pipelines, services, and platform that bring ML models to life in production. In this role, you will Implement and enhance well-scoped software and data components within complex, business-critical services — from design input through coding, testing, deployment, and production support, with guidance on larger decisions. Build and maintain the data pipelines, services, and infrastructure that support model training, evaluation, and serving, working alongside ML engineers to turn experimental workflows into robust production systems. Contribute to batch and streaming (online) data and inference workflows, learning how models are trained, served, and monitored at scale. Instrument systems and pipelines to capture operational and quality metrics (latency, throughput, errors, and key business signals), and help diagnose and resolve production issues. Participate in code reviews, on-call rotations, and incident response, taking ownership of the reliability and observability of the components you build. Use AI as a co-pilot across the software development lifecycle — to clarify requirements, generate and refine code, and strengthen automated tests — and apply generative AI/LLM techniques where they add value. Experience And Qualifications Strong problem-solving skills — the ability to deeply understand a problem and reason clearly about the right approach — which we value above any single technology. 2+ years of relevant professional experience building and shipping production software, ideally including data-intensive or backend services in a cloud or hybrid environment. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or Equivalent related professional experience. A strong command of Python, along with experience building APIs and services (FastAPI, REST). Solid software engineering fundamentals — data structures, algorithms, testing, and version control. Experience building, deploying, and supporting distributed systems and cloud services on AWS, including contributing to monitoring, alerting, and basic performance improvements. Experience running containerized and orchestrated workloads with Kubernetes at scale. Working knowledge of Go and Spark (Scala/PySpark) or similar big data frameworks, including basic evaluation, optimization, and debugging of large-scale data processing applications. Familiarity with a range of databases (e.g., Hive, Iceberg, Postgres) and workflow orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow, Flyte, Argo). Exposure to MLOps practices (CI/CD for ML, experiment tracking, model registry, deployment and monitoring tooling) and to machine learning concepts or ML pipelines — deep ML expertise is not required, but curiosity and a willingness to grow into data/ML engineering are important. Hands-on experience using AI-assisted engineering tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or equivalent) in day-to-day work, consistent with Expedia Group's expectation that engineers actively build and apply AI skills. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job_accommodation. title: Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)
full_description: We are seeking a proactive Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) with 2 to 5 years of hands-on experience to maintain high availability, scalability, and performance across our AWS cloud ecosystem. In this role, you will bridge software engineering and operations by building automated delivery pipelines, implementing proactive monitoring, managing containerized applications, and driving incident response protocols. Key Responsibilities Reliability & Incident Management: Monitor production systems, lead operational triage, analyze root causes (RCA), and implement preventative measures to ensure system availability and performance. Application Performance Analysis: Analyze application metrics to identify performance bottlenecks and reliability risks, and work with development teams to resolve them. Cloud Infrastructure & Containerization: Manage and support AWS core compute and networking services (EC2, ECS Fargate, S3, VPC, Route 53). Maintain containerized workflows using Docker. Automation & IaC: Write and maintain Infrastructure as Code using AWS CloudFormation or Terraform to automate infrastructure provisioning and reduce operational toil. CI/CD Pipeline Support: Maintain and optimize automated build and deployment pipelines using Jenkins and shell/OS scripting. Observability & Alerting: Configure metrics, log aggregation, and alerting frameworks using Datadog or AWS CloudWatch to maintain proactive platform health monitoring. Cloud Security & Quality Governance: Maintain cloud perimeter security using AWS WAF and AWS GuardDuty, and assist with code quality and license compliance tools. Must-Have Qualifications & Skills Experience: 2 to 5 years of hands-on experience in SRE, DevOps, or Cloud Infrastructure Operations. Scripting: Strong scripting proficiency (Bash, PowerShell, or Python) for task automation, system support, and reducing operational toil. Containerization: Hands-on expertise with Docker for containerizing applications. Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Working experience with AWS CloudFormation or Terraform. AWS Core Services & Networking: Practical experience with VPC, Route 53, EC2, ECS Fargate, S3, AWS WAF, and AWS GuardDuty. CI/CD & Automation: Experience configuring and maintaining deployment pipelines in Jenkins. Observability: Practical experience establishing metrics, logs, and alerts in Datadog or AWS CloudWatch. Application Metrics & Performance Analysis: Deep knowledge of monitoring and interpreting application metrics (latency, throughput, error rates, resource utilization) to detect anomalies, diagnose performance issues, and drive corrective action. Good-to-Have Skills Programming Experience (Preferred): Hands-on programming experience in any language (C# or Python preferred), ideally at least 1 year of software development. AI in DevOps / Automation: Familiarity with integrating AI tools, protocols, or agents into DevOps workflows and operational automation. Identity & Access Management: Experience with Active Directory management. Code Quality & Security Tools: Familiarity with, or administration experience in, SonarQube and Mend (formerly WhiteSource). Modern CI/CD: Exposure to GitHub Actions. Enterprise Governance: Basic understanding of AWS Control Tower and AWS Security Hub. Core Competencies Strong analytical and troubleshooting mindset for incident triage. Drive to automate repetitive manual tasks and eliminate operational toil. Clear communication skills to collaborate with development teams and operational stakeholders Skills: python scripting,aws,docker,ci/cd,python,sre,infrastructure

title: Snowflake Engineer
full_description: Job Description We are looking for a Snowflake Engineer to join our Cloud Operations team and help run reliable, secure, scalable, and cost-efficient production platforms across a multi-cloud, multi-region, geo-distributed environment. The role is hands-on, Snowflake and BI Tools heavy and operationally focused, supporting SaaS services and infrastructure that must remain highly available and performant. You will work closely with engineering, security, and product teams to support day-to-day operations, improve automation, strengthen observability, and reduce cloud waste through disciplined resource management. This is a hybrid role requiring minimum 3 days per week in our Bangalore office. Job Requirements: 3+ years of hands-on experience administering and supporting Snowflake in enterprise environments. 2–3 years of experience managing cloud infrastructure and data platforms on AWS and/or Azure. Snowflake Certification (SnowPro Core or SnowPro Advanced). Experience administering one or more relational database platforms is a plus. Key Responsibilities Key Responsibilities: Configure, administer, and maintain the Snowflake data platform. Maintain and enhance the existing AWS/Azure cloud infrastructure and Snowflake services. Design and implement Snowflake architecture, including databases, schemas, virtual warehouses, security, RBAC, and governance best practices. Monitor Snowflake environments, troubleshoot incidents, and optimize platform performance and cost. Develop and maintain automation using SQL, SnowSQL, Snowflake Tasks, Streams, Stored Procedures, Python, and Shell scripting. Implement and manage data ingestion and integration using Snowflake Openflow, Snowpipe, and cloud storage integrations where applicable. Manage schema changes, database objects, data loading/unloading, Secure Data Sharing, replication, cloning, Time Travel, and disaster recovery. Improve platform availability, scalability, reliability, and operational efficiency through automation, monitoring, and process improvements. Attend service request ticket queues regularly and resolve service requests and incidents within defined SLAs. Work closely with various stakeholders to ensure feature enhancements, security, uptime, and scalability requirements are met. Participate in 24x7 on-call rotation schedule and respond to occasional off-hour outages and take part in subsequent service restoration efforts.

title: Staff Database Reliability Engineer
full_description: Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world! Staff Database Reliability Engineer (DBRE) - Data Platform OpenSearch Must-Have | Distributed Systems | Kafka | Redis | Capacity Engineering | Automation Level Staff DBRE (Senior Individual Contributor / Technical Lead) Domain Distributed Data Platforms Primary Focus Cross-team architecture and systemic reliability for OpenSearch-centered data platforms, with Kafka, Redis, capacity engineering, and Python automation Work Expectations U.S. Eastern Time business hours; on-call participation as required Role Summary We are seeking an experienced Staff DBRE with deep OpenSearch/Elasticsearch expertise and strong distributed-systems judgment. The role leads high-impact architecture, reliability, performance, scalability, capacity, and lifecycle improvements across major data-platform services, complemented by Kafka, Redis, Linux, observability, and Python automation. The Staff DBRE solves ambiguous cross-team problems, establishes reusable platform patterns, mentors senior engineers, and influences multiple engineering groups. The scope extends beyond a single cluster or incident while remaining hands-on and evidence-driven. Level Scope and Leadership Expectations Staff DBRE is a senior individual-contributor technical leadership role focused on solving ambiguous, high-impact reliability and architecture problems across platforms and teams. The role has broad influence within the data-platform domain, while enterprise-wide cross-domain strategy remains a Principal-level responsibility. Dimension Expectation at This Level Scope of Ownership Owns complex cross-team reliability, scalability, performance, capacity, architecture, and operational-maturity problems across major OpenSearch-centered platform services. Technical Depth Serves as a domain authority in OpenSearch and distributed-systems failure modes, with strong supporting depth in Kafka, Redis, JVM, Linux, storage, and networking. Engineering Leadership Defines platform-domain patterns, mentors Senior and Lead engineers, raises design-review and incident-analysis rigor, and influences adjacent teams. Automation Architecture Designs reusable Python automation, observability, validation, and lifecycle-management patterns rather than isolated scripts. Execution Drives ambiguous initiatives from problem framing through design, alignment, implementation guidance, and measurable outcomes. Organizational Influence Influences multiple engineering groups through data, production evidence, design standards, and technical judgment; does not unilaterally set enterprise strategy. Key Responsibilities OpenSearch Platform Architecture Design and improve large-scale OpenSearch/Elasticsearch topology, dedicated node roles, shard and index strategies, lifecycle management, workload distribution, and recovery patterns. Solve complex indexing, search, cluster-state, JVM/GC, storage, segment, mapping, allocation, and cross-cluster reliability problems. Establish domain-level resilience, snapshot, replication, upgrade, and capacity patterns appropriate to the actual scale of the environment. Kafka and Redis Reliability Guide Kafka topology, partitioning, replication, capacity, consumer reliability, and failure-mode remediation for critical services. Guide Redis Cluster and Sentinel architecture, memory and eviction behavior, persistence tradeoffs, failover, re-sharding, and client reliability. Automation, Observability, and Capacity Engineering Architect reusable Python tooling and safe remediation frameworks for provisioning, validation, maintenance, scaling, and incident prevention. Define domain-level observability, SLIs/SLOs, capacity models, lifecycle forecasts, and actionable risk thresholds. Establish Infrastructure-as-Code and operator patterns where they improve repeatability and supportability. Technical Strategy and Cross-Team Leadership Lead architecture and production-readiness reviews for the data-platform domain. Evaluate emerging technologies through workload-relevant benchmarks, failure testing, operability reviews, and total-cost considerations. Lead complex technical investigations and systemic corrective actions; mentor engineers and improve engineering practices across teams. Required Qualifications and Experience 8+ years of DBRE, SRE, database, or distributed data-platform engineering experience with Staff, Lead, or comparable technical leadership scope. Deep hands-on mastery of OpenSearch and/or Elasticsearch internals, operations, performance, lifecycle management, recovery, and architecture. Strong production experience with Kafka and/or Redis, with the ability to reason across distributed data-platform failure modes. Strong systems expertise across JVM, Linux, CPU, memory, storage I/O, networking, and capacity behavior. Strong Python software-engineering capability for reusable production automation and tooling. Demonstrated success solving ambiguous cross-team technical problems and influencing architecture through evidence and judgment. Strong incident leadership, written communication, mentoring, and design-review skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience with both Kafka and Redis at meaningful production scale. Kubernetes operators, Terraform, Ansible, GitOps, and cloud-managed data services. Experience evaluating ClickHouse, Pinot, vector databases, or stream-processing technologies. Experience with chaos testing, production-readiness reviews, and cost-aware capacity engineering. Expected Outcomes in the First 6-12 Months Establish measurable reliability, capacity, lifecycle, and operational-maturity baselines for critical data-platform services and lead material improvements. Deliver reusable automation and observability patterns that reduce systemic toil and improve safe execution across teams. Publish and drive adoption of domain-level architecture, production-readiness, capacity, and resilience standards. Resolve one or more high-impact systemic risks and develop a prioritized multi-quarter improvement roadmap for the data-platform domain. What This Role Does Not Include This is not a people-management role unless separately assigned; leadership is exercised through technical influence and mentorship. This is not a coordination-only role; the Staff DBRE must remain hands-on and capable of deep technical investigation. This role does not replace ownership held by application, SRE, infrastructure, network, storage, or cloud teams. This is not a ticket-queue role limited to incident response and routine operations; systemic improvement is expected. This role does not unilaterally define enterprise-wide cross-domain architecture or approval policy; that scope belongs to Principal-level and executive governance. Work Expectations and Location This role requires working during U.S. Eastern Time (ET) business hours and participating in on-call support as required.

full_description: About Onit We're redefining the future of legal operations through the power of AI. Our cutting-edge platform streamlines enterprise legal management, matter management, spend management and contract lifecycle processes, transforming manual workflows into intelligent, automated solutions. We’re a team of innovators using AI at the core to help legal departments become faster, smarter, and more strategic. As we continue to grow and expand the capabilities of our new AI-centric platform, we’re looking for bold thinkers and builders who are excited to shape the next chapter of legal tech. If you're energized by meaningful work, love solving complex problems, and want to help modernize how legal teams operate, we’d love to meet you. Position Summary The Data Engineer builds and operates the Databricks-based data pipelines that power a new customer-facing benchmarking capability in Onit's AI-driven legal operations platform. Integrating data from multiple source systems across enterprise legal management, matter management, and spend management, this role turns inconsistent, duplicated, and incomplete source data into a clean, reconciled, and trustworthy foundation for analytics. Working closely with the Data Architect, Data Scientist, and Product, the Data Engineer delivers reliable ingestion, entity resolution, and data quality measurement at scale, with multi-tenant data isolation and privacy built in. Key Responsibilities Pipeline Development: Design, build, and maintain scalable batch and incremental pipelines in Databricks (PySpark, Spark SQL, Delta Lake) that ingest data from multiple source systems into a medallion (bronze/silver/gold) architecture. Data Integration & Modelling: Implement the canonical data model defined with the Data Architect, so figures reconcile consistently across every product surface. Entity Resolution: Build production pipelines that resolve duplicate and conflicting records across systems that were never designed to reconcile with one another. Data Quality Engineering: Profile source data, implement automated data quality checks and expectations, and build monitoring and reporting so data quality stays continuously visible against defined targets. Orchestration & Reliability: Orchestrate and monitor jobs with Databricks Workflows, optimise Spark performance and cost, and troubleshoot pipeline failures. Governance & Privacy: Apply Unity Catalog governance, multi-tenant data isolation, and anonymisation and aggregation rules for pooled cross-customer analytics. Collaboration: Partner with the Data Scientist to productionise comparability models and data quality metrics, and with Engineering to expose curated data to the product. Required Skills 5+ years in data engineering or analytics engineering, building production data pipelines in a cloud environment. Hands-on Databricks experience: PySpark and Spark SQL, Delta Lake, Databricks Workflows/Jobs, and Unity Catalog. Strong SQL and Python, with solid data modelling skills (dimensional and/or canonical models) and experience with the lakehouse/medallion architecture. Practical experience with deduplication, record linkage, or entity resolution, and with diagnosing and remediating data quality problems at scale. Experience implementing automated data quality checks, pipeline monitoring, and Spark performance and cost optimisation. Experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred), Git-based version control, and CI/CD for data pipelines. Clear communication with data scientists, architects, and product stakeholders, including flagging data limitations early. Working proficiency with AI tools (e.g., Claude, Databricks Assistant, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate pipeline development, debugging, and documentation, with the judgment to validate AI-generated code before production use. Preferred Qualifications Databricks certification (e.g., Data Engineer Associate or Professional). Experience with streaming or incremental ingestion (e.g., Auto Loader, Structured Streaming, Delta Live Tables). Experience building data for benchmarks, scoring models, or analytics intended for external consumption. Experience with anonymisation, aggregation thresholds, or privacy-preserving analytics. Background in enterprise B2B SaaS or the legal technology domain. Benefits & Perks That Support You: Onit offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support the whole employee at work and beyond: Health Coverage: Employee and immediate family members. Time Away: Flexible paid time off and 10 company paid holidays annually. Family Support: Exceptional paid leave for birth parents, non-birth parents, and caregivers. Onit also offers surrogacy and adoption reimbursement. Income Protection: 100% employer-paid life and disability insurance. Additional Coverage Options: Voluntary benefits including hospital indemnity, critical illness, accident. Tax-Advantaged Accounts: Flexi, NPS. Community Engagement: One paid volunteer day each year to give back to the community. Our Commitment to Applicants We know that not everyone will check every box in a job description. At Onit, we value diversity, inclusion, and authenticity. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply. You may be exactly who we’re looking for. Onit Values Customer First - Customer success is our success. We deliver value, listen, and act on customer needs. Purposeful Innovation - Innovation fuels our growth. We harness creativity to solve problems and lead with the intentions and expertise. Win as One - Teamwork is how we win. We are accountable, act with integrity, and communicate openly. Intentional Growth - Our people are the difference. We create an environment with compelling work, impactful contributions, and career growth. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. Support load, stress, and volume testing for data-intensive applications. Identify performance bottlenecks and collaborate with engineering teams on improvements. Required Qualifications 5-8 years of experience in Software Quality Engineering, with significant hands-on experience in database and ETL testing. Strong experience in developing automated test scripts and reusable testing frameworks. Excellent SQL skills with expertise in complex queries, joins, aggregations, and data validation. Practical experience with PostgreSQL, StarRocks, Tableau, and GCP. Knowledge with GCP services such as BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Dataflow, or Cloud Composer. Proven experience validating end-to-end data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes. Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts, dimensional modeling, and data quality principles. Experience working in Agile delivery environments. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and stakeholder collaboration skills. Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills Performance testing experience for databases and large-scale data pipelines. full_description: Data & Business Intelligence Engineer – Investment Technology India (Remote) | Full-Time | Contract | Venture Capital / Investment Tech Placed by Hotsourced – connecting top Indian talent with world-class global companies Our client is a venture capital firm that has built a proprietary data infrastructure — a custom Airtable-based CRM feeding into a BigQuery data warehouse — to track deal flow, portfolio performance, and investment decisions. The core engineering foundation is already in place; this role is about operating, extending, and unlocking insight from that system , working closely with a non-technical investment team. This is a high-autonomy, high-trust role. You'll be the primary point of contact translating ambiguous business questions from investment professionals into accurate, reconciled answers — while also identifying opportunities to enrich and improve the underlying data using AI and automation. Company Overview Our client is a venture capital firm modernizing how deals are sourced, tracked, and evaluated. Their data stack — Airtable as the CRM/source of truth, BigQuery as the data warehouse, with lightweight automation layered on top — supports an investment team that needs fast, accurate answers to questions about their deal pipeline and portfolio. Role Overview As Data & Analytics Engineer, you'll own the day-to-day health and usability of an existing Airtable → BigQuery data pipeline. The majority of your work will involve writing and reasoning about SQL queries against BigQuery, reconciling data discrepancies, and translating ambiguous requests from non-technical stakeholders into precise, correct answers. A smaller but growing part of the role involves using AI/automation to enrich data where high-quality external datasets (e.g., Crunchbase, PitchBook) aren't practically accessible. This is not a greenfield "build everything from scratch" engineering role — the core pipeline architecture already exists. Success looks like: stakeholders get accurate answers quickly, data discrepancies get caught and resolved before they reach leadership, and the underlying data quality improves over time. Key Responsibilities Write and maintain SQL queries against BigQuery to answer recurring and ad hoc business questions from the investment team (e.g., deal flow funnel analysis, conversion rates, portfolio metrics) Proactively identify and resolve data reconciliation issues arising from the Airtable → BigQuery data flow (e.g., duplicate company/deal records, inconsistent field definitions, snapshot vs. event-level data mismatches) Translate ambiguous, non-technical requests into precise technical definitions — clarifying with stakeholders rather than assuming intent (e.g., "deals seen" could mean multiple different things depending on context) Support and extend the existing Airtable CRM, including feature requests, automations, and data cleaning as the schema evolves Maintain and lightly extend existing Airflow (Cloud Composer)-orchestrated data pipelines and Cloud Functions as needed Explore opportunities to use AI (e.g., Google AI Studio/Gemini, LLM-based enrichment) to fill data gaps where standard market-data subscriptions (Crunchbase, PitchBook, Harmonic) aren't a practical option Maintain data quality and governance standards across the pipeline Communicate findings and data limitations clearly to non-technical, finance-oriented stakeholders Required Qualifications Strong, hands-on SQL skills — comfortable writing complex queries independently against a cloud data warehouse (BigQuery preferred) Demonstrated experience reconciling data discrepancies and diagnosing "why don't these numbers match" problems in a real production dataset Working knowledge of BigQuery and the broader GCP ecosystem Experience with Airtable, including automations and/or scripting (or comparable low-code CRM/database tooling) Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with proven ability to translate technical findings for non-technical business stakeholders Strong independent judgment — comfortable working with ambiguity and making a judgment call on how to proceed without heavy oversight Experience working in a remote, asynchronous, high-autonomy setup Preferred / Nice to Have Experience with Apache Airflow (Cloud Composer) for pipeline orchestration Familiarity with Google Cloud Functions and Python for lightweight automation Exposure to AI/LLM-based workflows (RAG, prompt engineering, agentic automation) — particularly for data enrichment use cases Understanding of the venture capital lifecycle (sourcing, due diligence, investment committee, portfolio management) Familiarity with financial concepts such as IRR, MOIC, and cap tables Experience with data enrichment or web-scraping tools (e.g., PeopleDataLabs, Clearbit) Prior experience in a startup or lean team environment where you were the sole owner of a data function What Success Looks Like (3–6 Months) The investment team can get accurate answers to standard data questions instantly and without errors Recurring data quality issues are identified and resolved proactively rather than reactively You're beginning to surface additional insights and analysis on your own initiative, not just responding to requests Progress toward enriching incomplete data using AI/automation where paid data sources aren't accessible Work Schedule Monday to Friday 08:00 AM – 05:00 PM GMT / 01:30 PM – 10:30 PM IST Compensation 12–15 LPA INR (Annual)

full_description: How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities) The Predictive Engineering Data Scientist develops, trains, validates, and deploys machine learning and advanced predictive modeling solutions that identify emerging equipment degradation, predict component failures, and enable proactive maintenance actions across Delta’s fleet. Using full-flight and snapshot operational aircraft data, this role enables predictive maintenance and operational performance initiatives through scalable predictive models deployed across key platforms, such as GE EMS and Digital Alliance applications. The successful candidate applies strong expertise in machine learning, model training and validation, feature engineering, model deployment and operationalization, anomaly detection, and predictive analytics to transform operational data into predictive models that generate actionable maintenance intelligence, enabling proactive maintenance decisions and improving fleet reliability. Working with large-scale aircraft full-flight datasets, the Machine Learning Scientist develops and continuously improves predictive models that detect early indicators of system performance degradation and potential failures before they result in operational disruptions. This role owns the end-to-end development lifecycle of predictive machine learning solutions, from problem formulation, feature engineering, model architecture selection, algorithm evaluation, model development and optimization, training, validation through production deployment, performance monitoring, and continuous improvement. Many of the problems addressed by this position do not have predefined solutions. This candidate in this role must evaluate large and complex aircraft operational, flight, and maintenance datasets to identify meaningful patterns, engineer predictive features, select machine learning architectures, design and execute model experimentation, and research and develop new machine learning approaches capable of accurately modeling complex aircraft behavior and failure mechanisms. This role requires significant independent judgment in problem formulation, analytical methodology selection, feature engineering, model architecture design, validation strategies, and production deployment approaches. In this role, you will: Lead and participate in moderately complex data quality, data governance, metadata, and data management initiatives supporting business processes and downstream data consumption. Analyze complex datasets using SQL to identify data defects, perform root-cause analysis, and drive remediation of data quality, integrity, process, and control gaps. Analyze, assess, and test data controls and data systems to ensure compliance with data quality, risk, and governance standards and procedures. Define and evaluate data quality metrics, execute data quality assessments and audits, and provide recommendations to management on the overall state of data and metadata quality. Assess new data sources and develop appropriate approaches for measuring, monitoring, and maintaining data quality. Partner with business, technology, data product, and data integrity stakeholders to coordinate solution design, remediation planning, and execution. Develop clear business metadata, data dictionaries, requirements, specifications, and supporting documentation to improve consistent understanding and use of data. Support data analysis and reporting associated with applicable regulatory requirements. Participate in cross-functional initiatives supporting broader enterprise data governance strategies and priorities. full_description: At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. Job Description Technical Product Manager – Lilly USA Data Analytics & AI (DA&AI) At Lilly, we believe in the talent of our workforce. One of the best ways to utilize and develop that talent is to use our existing workforce to fill new and/or open positions. If you are looking for a new position within Lilly, you can view and apply to open roles posted in the internal job posting system. You must meet the minimum qualifications outlined in the job description and have or obtain work authorization in the country where the position is to be considered. When applying internally, your current supervisor will receive notification that you have applied. We encourage employees to discuss the opportunity with their supervisor before applying. Path/Level P3 Job Title Technical Product Manager, Lilly USA Tech@Lilly – DA&AI Job Function Information Technology Location India – Bangalore Reports to Director, CTI Commercial India, Tech@Lilly Note: Roles are posted at the lowest level of a band. Employees hired into banded positions transfer at their current level, despite the level indicated in the posting. Role Overview The Technical Product Manager (TPM) owns the product vision, roadmap, prioritization and value realization for Lilly USA Commercial Sales data and analytics products. The role translates the needs of Sales Operations, field leadership and commercial teams into trusted, reusable data products and analytical capabilities that improve field effectiveness, customer engagement and business decision-making. This individual-contributor role combines strong Commercial Sales stakeholder partnership with formal product management accountability. It moves beyond demand intake and status coordination to owning product outcomes, roadmap decisions, prioritization, adoption and measurable business value. The TPM owns the Sales vertical product direction and business outcomes while partnering with platform Product Owners, Data Architects, Business Analysts, Scrum Masters, engineering, quality and compliance teams that retain accountability for their respective platform, architecture and delivery responsibilities. Key Responsibilities Product vision, strategy and roadmap Define and communicate a multi-quarter data-product vision and roadmap for Commercial Sales, aligned with Commercial Unit priorities and the broader Data & AI strategy. Translate business problems such as field effectiveness, targeting and customer engagement into validated product opportunities, data requirements and measurable outcomes. Prioritize the roadmap and backlog using business value, urgency, strategic alignment, effort, risk, compliance, capacity and dependency trade-offs; make and defend scope decisions with leadership. Maintain a transparent roadmap, release outlook and product lifecycle plan, clearly communicating changes in priorities, capacity, funding or dependencies. Align the Sales roadmap with reusable enterprise capabilities, platform roadmaps and relevant AI innovation initiatives before approving vertical-specific development. Product discovery and data-product definition Lead structured discovery with field users, Sales Operations, reporting teams to understand decisions, workflows, unmet needs and pain points before defining solutions. Validate problems and proposed product concepts through interviews, workflow observation, prototypes, data analysis, usability testing and field feedback. Define the business contract for each Sales data product, including intended consumers, decision use cases, product grain, key identifiers, business definitions, source systems, refresh expectations, quality thresholds, access requirements and service expectations, in partnership with the Business Analyst and Data Architect. Maintain a clear product catalogue covering product purpose, business owner, product owner, consumers, lifecycle status, dependencies, service expectations and adoption measures. End-to-end product delivery and acceptance Own product outcomes from validated opportunity through production adoption, including scope, prioritization, release decisions, enablement and post-launch value tracking. Own product priorities, backlog ordering and timely scope decisions; partner with the Business Analyst to translate outcomes into epics, features, user stories, data requirements and acceptance criteria. Partner with the Scrum Master so planning refinement, reviews and delivery ceremonies support product priorities and timely decisions. Work with data engineers, analysts, ML engineers, quality teams and architects to resolve product questions and make informed value, usability, risk and sequencing trade-offs. Establish business acceptance criteria, coordinate UAT with authorized Sales stakeholders and secure business sign-off before release. Ensure critical Sales measures are reconciled across source systems, data products and consuming reports before production adoption. Coordinate product acceptance and operational handover to downstream analytics and reporting teams, including documentation, access, support ownership and known limitations. Track delivery and product health, proactively surfacing risks, dependencies, quality concerns, cost considerations and mitigation decisions. Stakeholder, portfolio and operating-model leadership Act as the single point of accountability and voice of the product for Commercial business partners, Sales Operations, field leadership and technology stakeholders. Lead regular Sales product reviews covering roadmap, value realized, adoption, product health, dependencies, risks and decisions required. Lead quarterly demand, capacity and sequencing discussions for the Sales data-product portfolio, balancing business value, urgency, strategic alignment, risk, technical dependencies and available delivery capacity. Assess existing enterprise data products, approved patterns and reusable platform capabilities before starting new development. Contribute to maintaining the Sales DA&AI operating model, decision rights and RACI, recommending updates when product, platform or delivery accountabilities change. Provide concise executive updates and evidence-based investment recommendations, including the consequences of funding, capacity and sequencing decisions. Data, AI and regulated-environment stewardship Champion and apply architecture, data-governance, privacy, security, quality and compliance standards established by the accountable enterprise teams. Promote trusted business definitions, data quality, lineage, appropriate access and a consistent source of truth for Sales and Commercial measures. Identify and validate Sales problems that may benefit from analytics, machine learning, generative AI or agentic capabilities. Partner with Business Analysts and engineering teams to assess feasibility, data readiness, responsible-AI considerations and measurable business value. Support the transition of successful proofs of concept into governed, supportable and adoptable Sales products. Value realization, adoption and lifecycle management Define success measures before investment and track outcomes after release, using appropriate business, product, data-quality, adoption and delivery measures. Drive change management, training, communications and field enablement so intended users adopt and benefit from the products. Continuously improve products through evidence-based releases, address low adoption or quality concerns and retire low-value or duplicative capabilities. Role Accountability and Decision Rights The TPM is accountable for why the product is needed, whom it serves, what outcomes it must deliver, what is prioritized and whether value is realized. The TPM partners with the Business Analyst on detailed requirements, the Scrum Master on delivery ceremonies, the Data Architect on architecture and governance standards, engineering and quality teams on implementation and validation, and platform Product Owners on reusable capabilities and technical roadmaps. Qualifications and Skills Required Relevant experience in technology, data, analytics or digital product delivery, including substantial experience owning data, analytics or AI products in complex enterprise environments. Proven record of owning product discovery, vision, roadmap, prioritization, delivery, adoption and lifecycle management in an Agile environment such as Scrum or SAFe. Experience working with Commercial Sales, Sales Operations, CRM, field-force or customer-engagement data and platforms such as Salesforce, Veeva or similar. Strong data literacy, including the ability to interpret data models, SQL outputs, dashboards, business measures, quality indicators and analytical results. Working knowledge of modern cloud data and analytics platforms, such as Databricks and AWS, including Lakehouse concepts, data pipelines, data modelling, semantic layers, business intelligence and ML/AI product lifecycles. The role is not expected to be a hands-on data engineer but must engage credibly with technical teams and make informed product trade-offs. Experience with product discovery, outcome-based roadmaps, business acceptance, UAT, product adoption and measurable product KPIs. Experience managing priorities, dependencies, capacity and sequencing across multiple business and delivery teams. Working knowledge of Jira or Azure DevOps for product backlog and roadmap management. Demonstrated understanding of data governance, privacy, security, quality, compliance and responsible AI in a regulated environment. Excellent written and verbal communication, stakeholder management, negotiation and consulting skills, including the ability to influence senior leaders and global cross-time-zone teams without formal authority. Preferred Pharma, life sciences or healthcare Commercial experience across brand, sales operations, market access, marketing analytics or omnichannel engagement. Experience with AI/ML or generative-AI product use cases such as next-best action, forecasting, recommendation or copilots for Sales users. Experience handing data products over to downstream analytics, reporting or decision-support platforms. Familiarity with tools and services such as Confluence, Databricks, AWS, Power BI, Tableau, Redshift or Amazon S3. One of the Product, Agile certifications such as CSPO, SAFe POPM, PMP would be advantage. Leadership Behaviors Creates urgency and momentum while making thoughtful product trade-offs. Influences without authority across multiple levels and functions. Communicates clearly, listens actively and builds trusted stakeholder relationships. Works constructively through ambiguity and keeps teams focused on outcomes and decisions. Uses analytical and critical thinking to identify product, data and delivery gaps. Balances customer advocacy with enterprise reuse, governance, quality and long-term product sustainability.
